method: Image-generated PNGs copied without pixel edits. Atlas registration and anatomical hurtboxes are metadata.

generations.prompt: Create production 2D fighting game sprite art on TRUE transparent PNG alpha. Match the approved SMOKE reference exactly: adult slim mature alchemist with olive gold-trim hood, long dark brown almost black hair, ivory puff-sleeve blouse, dark brown buckled waist corset, long split ragged ivory coat tails with olive lining, fitted strapped charcoal trousers, brown strapped boots, dark fingerless gloves and brass/lime potion vials. Crisp dark contour, restrained olive/ivory/brown colors, clean hard-edged cel shading. Fixed three-quarter side camera facing SCREEN RIGHT. Constant anatomy, face, head size, costume design and local color across frames. NO text, borders, grid lines, labels, floor lines, shadows, weapons, attack trails, smear frames, gradients, backgrounds or particles. Each cell stays completely separated by empty transparent gutters, no clipping or neighboring fragments. Use ONLY option A / OPEN CURRENT (upper-left quadrant of the reference). Four subtle keyframes of that exact standing idle loop, arranged in a strict 2 columns by 2 rows grid on a 1536x1024 canvas; each logical cell 768x512. Each complete full-body figure fits in local x=200..540 and y=35..480. Center the pelvis over local x=390. The grounded boot forefoot remains at local (430,480) in EVERY cell. Body is about 440 pixels upright with an anatomical head about 50 pixels high. Arms gently spread low and open with palms up, tall upright soft spine, shoulders relaxed, legs close and slightly staggered, BOTH heels gently lifted, toes lightly contacting ground, nearly weightless but not airborne. Faithfully keep A's gesture and narrow leg spacing. Loop keys row-major: 1 lower/relaxed, 2 gentle inhale/lift by just 3px, 3 crest by just 5px, 4 softly settling halfway back. Foot contact unchanged. Small changes in elbow/wrist, hair and coat tails only; no whole-character resize. Hair/coat tails drift backward toward screen left, but remain in cell. The smoke effect will be drawn on a SEPARATE LAYER: absolutely NO SMOKE, gas or visual effect in this BODY sprite atlas. All four should match the same approved A stance, not four different poses.

Edit this eight-frame SMOKE EFFECT atlas for production transparency. Preserve its 4 columns x 2 rows layout, gray/olive S-curve shapes, subtle lime edges and sequential curl changes. REMOVE the ENTIRE diffuse cloudy background, glow, foggy haze and gray/white matte surrounding the actual smoke curls. Every pixel outside the clearly defined curling shapes must be fully transparent alpha 0, including the empty center between curves. The only visible pixels are the crisp CEL-SHADED gray curling shapes themselves with their narrow lime accents. No aura, bloom, shadow or semitransparent full-cell rectangles. Keep each key entirely inside its 384x512 cell, at least 20px empty fully transparent margin from every cell edge; shorten/recenter the tallest curl slightly in cells3–5 to ensure this. Strong clean alpha-separated objects, like cutout effect sprites. TRUE transparent PNG. No character, lettering or floor. Keep 1536x1024 image and identical frame order.

previous.prompt: Create a TRUE transparent PNG animation sprite atlas containing ONLY the separate looping SMOKE EFFECT seen behind the approved reference character. NO person, clothing, anatomy, boots, floor shadow, ground line, lettering or background. Strict FOUR columns by TWO rows, 1536x1024 canvas, EIGHT uniform 384x512 cells in row-major animation order. Each cell contains the same two softly curling vertical smoke columns, asymmetric and lightweight, made of connected rounded lobes and open S curves. Colors muted slate-gray #89908A with olive-gray shadows and a very restrained thin lime #A4CA35 edge; mostly gray, not bright toxic green. Crisp stylized anime cel shading matches reference, softly tapering edges but no hazy full-cell glow. The smoke is ambient idle vapor, NOT fire, lightning, torn fabric, wings, tornado or a closed ring. Empty central corridor to leave the fighter silhouette readable. Broad curl behind the upper left/shoulder; narrower lower curl on the right, rising slowly from near the ankles. Every cell completely separated by generous transparent gutters: visible pixels only within local x=24..360, y=30..480. Root at local (192,480), total effect height about450. Eight gently advancing loop keys: curls drift upward and outward by small increments while lower lobes renew; final key naturally reconnects to first. Preserve volume and character-specific shape language; coherent calm looping smoke, no sudden blooms or detached particles. No grids or labels. This effect will render BEHIND Smoke.
previous.rejection: Diffuse alpha haze reached atlas cell edges. Image generator removed haze and repaired gutters.
